segments.text: If the apocalypse starts while you're driving a train, you might be the luckiest person alive.
Nothing can catch you, unless you forget one thing.
Meet Joel. He's 45. He drives the night train from the city to the coast.
200 passengers ride behind him. Every night is the same.
Check the brakes. Check the fuel for a coffee.
All trains, mass infection in the city.
Do not stop. Do not open the doors.
Joel's first thought was to stop at the next station and go back for his daughter.
But every station is packed with people running from the city, and some of them are already infected.
The train had one huge advantage. At 120 kilometers an hour, nothing on foot can keep up.
He checked what he had. Fuel for 2,000 kilometers, a dining car with food for a week, full water tanks.
Then he locked every door from the cab. Speed, check, fuel, check, doors, check.
Joel had thought of everything. But Joel forgot one thing.
What did he forget? Tell me in the comments.
